### Failed Payments Analysis & Recovery Plan

**1. Outage Alert**
Likely bank outage: HDFC Bank (UPI) dominates today's failures, with 40.4% of all failure occurrences and ₹19,41,677 in lost amount. The team has been flagged for a probable HDFC UPI gateway downtime.

**2. Top 4 Failure Causes & Recovery Actions**

| Rank | Error code & channel | Share | Lost amount | Recommended action | Recovery chance | Est. recoverable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | UPI_TIMEOUT (HDFC, UPI) | 40.4% | ₹19,41,677 | Auto-retry in 30 minutes; alert team | 60% | ₹11,65,006 |
| 2 | INVALID_CVV (ICICI, Card) | 12.9% | ₹6,57,097 | Send customer a link to re-enter card details | 70% | ₹4,59,968 |
| 3 | INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS (SBI, Card) | 10.8% | ₹5,96,614 | Send reminder after 24 hours with payment link | 25% | ₹1,49,154 |
| 4 | NETWORK_ERROR (Paytm, Wallet) | 8.2% | ₹4,21,434 | Auto-retry immediately | 65% | ₹2,73,932 |

**Total estimated recoverable revenue (top 4): ₹20,48,060 (about ₹20.48 lakh)**

**3. Sample customer recovery message (simulated)**
Sent to cust_1 for the top customer-fixable issue (INVALID_CVV): "Hi, your recent payment could not be processed due to an incorrect CVV. Please click here to re-enter your card details securely and complete your payment."

**4. Items requiring human approval (over ₹5 lakh)**
- HDFC UPI (UPI_TIMEOUT): ₹19,41,677 lost. Needs manual review and contact with HDFC before batch retries.
- ICICI Card (INVALID_CVV): ₹6,57,097 lost. Needs approval for bulk customer recovery links.
- SBI Card (INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS): ₹5,96,614 lost. Needs approval for bulk payment reminders.
